title: torilis nodosa subsp. bracteosa
intro: Torilis nodosa subsp. bracteosa, commonly known as Wild Chamomile or Honeywort, is a species of flowering plant in the carrot family, native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Torilis nodosa subsp. bracteosa include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects. The health benefits of this plant include alleviating symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome, reducing anxiety and stress, and supporting the immune system.
